title: Testing ArcCaptain's App-Controlled Welding Rig
summary: Experienced welders tested ArcCaptain's hobbyist-to-light-industrial-grade double-pulse machine and evaluated its app-based controls.

title: Advancing Computational Lithography for Next-Gen Scaling
summary: New models, AI, and cross-industry collaboration are needed to extend semiconductor scaling beyond current edge placement error budgets.

title: Extending Silicon Characterization Beyond PVT Workloads
summary: Silicon characterization must account for real-world workloads because devices at identical voltage, frequency, and temperature can behave differently.

title: Self-Aligned CFET Technology for Sub-10 Å CMOS Scaling
summary: A new process sequence for SRAM and logic delivers improved performance and electrostatics at smaller nodes.

title: Foundries and OSATs Overlap as Packaging Grows
summary: Advanced packaging growth and capacity constraints are driving traditional foundries and OSATs into increasingly overlapping territory.

title: Toyota Enters Hydrogen Truck in 2027 Dakar Rally
summary: Toyota announced plans to enter a hydrogen fuel cell version of its Hilux truck in the January 2027 Dakar Rally.

title: Photon Bridge Secures €10M for AI Lasers
summary: Dutch photonics specialist Photon Bridge raised €10 million to produce millions of lasers for AI infrastructure connectivity.

title: Private Wireless RAN Revenue Growth Moderates
summary: Dell'Oro reports that private wireless radio access network revenue growth slowed to the mid-single digits in the first half of the year.

title: Startup Reinvents Nuclear Manufacturing with Shipyard-Built Reactors
summary: Blue Energy manufactures giant pieces of nuclear reactors at shipyards and ships them on barges to lower costs.

title: Amazon Opens In-House Robotics Production Facility
summary: Amazon is addressing its demand for robotics internally by launching a new automation production facility.

title: AW-0 Framework Integrates Code-Based Planning and Video Prediction
summary: Researchers introduced AW-0, an agentic world action model that combines code-based planning with joint video and action prediction for robot manipulation.

title: Unified Capability Framework for Multimodal Embodied Agents
summary: Researchers introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework that defines multimodal embodied agents through five recurring functions: perceive, anticipate, plan, act, and verify.

title: Dynamic Microsegmentation for Multi-Robot Networks
summary: A laboratory demonstration shows that dynamic microsegmentation can automatically isolate network threats in real time across a multi-robot IoT network while maintaining operations.

title: Machine-Learning Approaches in Wireless Power Transfer
summary: A comprehensive review examines how machine learning supports structural optimization, parameter estimation, and adaptive control in wireless power transfer systems.

title: AtomicRL for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: AtomicRL is a reinforcement learning post-training framework that uses atomic task structures and semantic-aware gating to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation.

title: Evaluating Humanoid Locomotion Across Gravity and Soil
summary: Simulations test how humanoid locomotion policies transfer across different gravity levels, terrain geometries, and soil models using a Unitree G1 robot.

title: NLOS-Aware TDOA-Based UAV Localization
summary: Researchers develop NLOS-aware Cramér-Rao bounds and measurement models for TDOA-based passive UAV localization, validated using flight test data.

title: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on Robot Manipulation
summary: A closed-loop evaluation framework assesses six frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark for direct robot control without task-specific training.

title: SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: SP-HLM combines sparse body poses with a learned latent motion prior to improve whole-body control and task coordination for humanoid robots.

title: Revisiting Dual Effect and Certainty Equivalence in Control
summary: This paper revisits certainty equivalence and dual effect in linear-Gaussian control models, introducing a Bellman-side no-dual-effect condition characterized by a heat equation.

title: Parametric MISOCP Model for Merchant MTDC Siting and Sizing
summary: Researchers propose a sharing-rate-parameterized mixed-integer second-order cone programming model to optimize VSC siting and sizing while balancing AC/DC grid economics.

title: Multiuser Channel Estimation for Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces
summary: A structured block term decomposition estimator is developed to address multiuser channel estimation challenges in flexible intelligent metasurfaces.

title: Convex Koopman Controller Synthesis for Constrained Tracking
summary: A constrained Koopman Control Parametrization framework synthesizes state-feedback controllers satisfying input constraints with Lyapunov-certified stability.

title: Active Perception Framework for Safe Mobile Manipulation
summary: An active perception framework integrates next-best-view observation with model predictive control to enable safe navigation and inspection for mobile manipulators.

title: Plantbench Library for Plantwide Process Control Simulations
summary: Plantbench introduces a library of plantwide process simulations using hashed plain-data configurations to reproduce design, tuning, and instrumentation.

title: Worst-Case Finite-Horizon Analysis of Perturbed LQR via PEP
summary: An exact formulation using the Performance Estimation Problem framework quantifies the finite-horizon robustness of LQR systems subject to parametric uncertainties.

title: Socionext Expands AI-Based Design Across SoC Development
summary: Socionext is applying Cadence tools to a 3nm SoC and integrating internal engineering knowledge into design workflows.

title: Global Satcom Services Revenues Projected at $145 Billion by 2035
summary: Novaspace forecasts global satellite services revenues to grow 44% and reach $145 billion by 2035.

title: AGCO to Deploy Agility Digit Humanoid in Kansas Factory
summary: AGCO plans to pilot the Agility Digit humanoid at an agricultural equipment production facility starting in 2027.

title: Scientists Solve 178-Year-Old Solar Storm Train Delay Mystery
summary: Researchers determined a historic solar storm train delay occurred in 1848 instead of 1841, reshaping space weather history.
